capabilityManifest.tagline: A prediction engine setup shortcut with built-in credibility gates.
capabilityManifest.firstCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"

helpsWith.label: Prediction engine setup shortcut
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Guides agents from a host prediction goal to contracts, source roles, baselines, forecast cards, resolvers, scorers, and calibration gates.

helpsWith.label: Resolvable forecast contracts
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Turns vague prediction ideas into future-facing questions with horizons and resolution rules.

helpsWith.label: Evidence provenance
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Records which source roles and forecast-time evidence supported a prediction.

helpsWith.label: Baseline comparison
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Keeps new methods honest by comparing them against simple baselines before stronger claims.

helpsWith.label: Resolution and scoring
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Separates forecast-time evidence from outcome evidence and scores resolved forecasts.

helpsWith.label: Calibration gates
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Blocks calibration and quality claims until enough comparable resolved outcomes exist.

helpsWith.label: Agent-safe readbacks
helpsWith.whyItMatters: Gives agents compact commands and schema-bound records instead of free-form oracle output.

doesNotProvide.label: Frontend or dashboard
doesNotProvide.replacement: Build UI in the host app and render OPE forecast cards.

doesNotProvide.label: Hosted API
doesNotProvide.replacement: Use local CLI, in-process calls, agent-call, or local MCP until a transport is checked.

doesNotProvide.label: Trained model out of the box
doesNotProvide.replacement: Bring a model and compare it through OPE method and scoring gates.

doesNotProvide.label: Generic web crawler
doesNotProvide.replacement: Provide approved sources or checked adapters under source policy.

doesNotProvide.label: Production scheduler
doesNotProvide.replacement: Use host scheduling; OPE only exposes checked local readbacks today.

fitDecision.recommendedFirstAction: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"
fitDecision.claimBoundary: Use OPE to set up the engine skeleton and credibility gates; do not claim quality before resolved comparable evidence exists.

compactEntryPoints.command: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"
compactEntryPoints.purpose: Turn a host prediction goal into candidate contracts, source roles, baseline guidance, forecast-card preview shape, host-wrapper shape, and claim boundaries.
Show generic non-Helsinki setup examples before an agent maps a host goal to OPE fields.

compactEntryPoints.command: python3 scripts/ope.py explain-fit --goal "add predictions to my app"
compactEntryPoints.purpose: Tell an agent whether OPE fits a host prediction goal and which parts the host must bring.
Emit the machine-readable capability manifest for automated tool selection.
Run the first-five-minutes adoption checklist without live network access or writes.
Return the checked quickstart sequence for agents embedding OPE in a host project.

extensionPoints.description: A host or agent converts an external data source into sanitized OPE source-adapter output.
extensionPoints.hostProvides: Approved source refs, field mappings, and sanitized rows or manifests.
extensionPoints.opeChecks: Source policy, mapping confidence, leakage, freshness, and role fit.

extensionPoints.description: A host plugs in deterministic or model-assisted forecast output for OPE comparison.
extensionPoints.hostProvides: Method metadata, forecast output, training cutoff, and feature provenance.
extensionPoints.opeChecks: Baseline comparison, benchmark binding, anti-leakage, and method eligibility.

extensionPoints.description: A host supplies outcome evidence after the resolution window closes.
extensionPoints.hostProvides: Resolution-only source rows and outcome observation timestamps.
extensionPoints.opeChecks: Forecast-before-outcome boundary, declared resolution rule, and unscorable status.

extensionPoints.description: A host reads or extends scoring reports after outcomes are resolved.
extensionPoints.hostProvides: Resolved outcomes, forecast IDs, and accepted scoring rule choices.
extensionPoints.opeChecks: Score binding, baseline lift, exclusion reasons, and comparable sample boundaries.
extensionPoints.firstReadbackCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py agent-call --operation scoring_summary --forecast-id forecast-1102 --question-id question-1102

extensionPoints.description: A host app wraps OPE readbacks in its own API, UI, worker, or product flow.
extensionPoints.hostProvides: Product UI, auth, runtime, scheduling, notifications, and user workflow.
extensionPoints.opeChecks: Claim boundaries, forecast-card readbacks, lifecycle bundles, and safe blocked paths.

steps: Define the forecast contract and close/resolution windows before training.
Bind forecast-time features and keep outcome rows resolution-only.
Run or register a baseline before selecting the custom model.
Compare the model against the baseline on comparable resolved outcomes.
Report quality or calibration only after OPE gates show enough evidence.

checks.command: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"
checks.expected: Agent can explain that OPE is an engine setup shortcut with credibility gates, not the full app stack.
Agent can identify the first command without reading the whole README.
Agent can pass decision context, outcome, horizon, source hints, and safety flags when app context exists.
Agent can read machine-readable helps-with and does-not-provide lists.
Agent can find where to plug in sources, methods, resolvers, scorers, and host wrappers.
Agent can see hosted runtime, trained-model, frontend, and quality-claim boundaries.

checks.command: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add stockout-risk prediction to an inventory app"
checks.expected: Agent starts with setup-engine before proposing a separate lightweight risk engine.
Agent can see audit-layer-only framing as a comprehension signal, not OPE's product role.

summary.firstCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py setup-engine --goal "add predictions to my app"

warnings: This surface is an adoption guide and engine setup shortcut, not a new prediction execution path.
OPE remains local and read-only by default; hosted runtime and live effects require separate checked gates.
Bring custom models and app runtime from the host project, then compare them through OPE records.
